item.title: Cancellation Policy
item.dc:creator: Vitthal Mirji
item.description:
This policy covers cancellations for consulting and learning services purchased via vitthalmirji.com.

1. One-off sessions

  • You can cancel or reschedule with 24 hours notice.
  • Cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows are treated as a delivered session, unless we agree otherwise in writing.

2. Project engagements

  • Cancellation must be communicated in writing (email is fine).
  • Work completed up to the cancellation date will be billed.
  • Any unused prepaid amount may be refunded as per the Refund Policy.

3. Monthly and yearly subscriptions

  • You can cancel anytime before the next billing date.
  • Access and support continue until the end of the paid period.
  • Unused hours do not carry forward unless agreed in writing.
  • No prorated refunds unless required by law.

4. How to cancel

Email vitthalmirji@gmail.com with your invoice reference and the effective cancellation date.

  1. Choose a service from Services .

  4. You receive a payment confirmation (gateway + email).

  6. Service is delivered as per the agreed scope and timelines.

If you need a custom payment link or invoice, email vitthalmirji@gmail.com .

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: Vitthal Mirji
item.content:encoded:
This Privacy Policy explains how VITTAL MIRJI (we, us, our) collects, uses, shares, and protects personal data when you use vitthalmirji.com (Website) or purchase services.

Technical consulting services. No physical goods. No restricted categories.

1. What we collect

Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect:

  • Identity and contact info: name, email, phone, company, role
  • Communication content: emails, messages, meeting notes you send us
  • Billing details: invoice references, payment status, partial payment identifiers (we do not store full card details)
  • Technical data: IP address, browser/device info, approximate location, pages visited (via cookies/analytics if enabled)

2. How we use your data

We use personal data to:

  • Provide consulting services and deliver agreed work
  • Create invoices, confirm payments, and maintain accounting records
  • Respond to requests and support queries
  • Prevent fraud/abuse and secure our Website
  • Comply with legal obligations

3. Payments and payment processors

Payments are processed through a payment gateway/aggregator (for example, Cashfree & PayU) and the banks/payment networks involved in processing. The payment processor handles sensitive payment credentials as per its systems and policies.

We may receive payment confirmation details such as transaction reference, amount, date, and status.

4. Legal basis and your rights

We process personal data for lawful purposes such as providing services you request, and where required, based on your consent.

Under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, you have rights including:

  • correction/updating and erasure (subject to legal retention needs)
  • readily available means of grievance redressal MeitY

5. Data sharing

We may share limited personal data with:

  • Payment processors (for example, Cashfree & PayU and associated banking/payment partners) for payment processing
  • Service providers we use to run the business (hosting, email, analytics, invoicing/accounting), under appropriate safeguards
  • Authorities, if required by law or to protect rights/safety

We do not sell your personal data.

6. Data retention

We retain personal data only as long as necessary for:

  • delivering services
  • resolving disputes
  • complying with legal/accounting requirements

7. Security

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect personal data. No method of transmission or storage is 100 percent secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

8. Cookies

We may use cookies to improve site functionality and understand traffic. You can control cookies through your browser settings. If you disable cookies, some parts of the site may not work as intended.

9. Children

This Website and Services are not directed to individuals under 18. If you believe a child has provided personal data, contact us and we will take appropriate steps.

10. Contact and grievance

For privacy requests or grievances, contact:

  • Privacy Contact: VITTAL MIRJI
  • Email: vitthalmirji@gmail.com
  • Mobile: +91-9845-630-306

We aim to respond within a reasonable time and as required by applicable law. MeitY

11. Updates

We may update this policy. The latest version will always be posted here with the updated date.

item.content:encoded:
This policy applies to consulting services purchased from VITTAL MIRJI via vitthalmirji.com and paid using online payment methods.

Technical consulting services. No physical goods. No restricted categories.

Returns do not apply because we do not sell physical goods.

1. Consulting services are generally non-refundable

Consulting time and delivered work are generally non-refundable once:

  • the engagement has started, or
  • a session has been conducted, or
  • a deliverable has been shared.

Why: the service is time and effort based, and value is delivered as work progresses.

2. When refunds may be granted

We may consider refunds in limited situations such as:

  • duplicate payment for the same invoice
  • payment made in error (wrong amount) and reported promptly
  • we are unable to start the engagement and no work has begun
  • a service was paid for but not provided due to our fault

Refund decisions are at our discretion unless required otherwise by applicable law.

3. Refund window and mode

  • Refund requests must be raised within 7 days of payment if the service has not started.
  • If the service has started or any deliverable has been shared, the fee is non-refundable, unless required by applicable law.
  • Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method (same card/bank account/UPI/wallet).

4. How refunds are processed

If a refund is approved:

  • refunds are initiated via the payment gateway dashboard/API
  • refunds are sent to the original payment source
  • the refunded amount is deducted from our settlement
  • processing time depends on the gateway used:
    • Cashfree (domestic): 5-7 business days
    • PayU (international/AMEX): 5-21 business days

5. Chargebacks and disputes

A chargeback is different from a refund. Chargebacks are initiated by the customer with their bank for reasons such as fraud, dissatisfaction, or service disputes.

If a chargeback occurs, we may submit documentation (invoice, written scope, delivery evidence, communication logs) to contest it.

6. Contact

To request a refund or reschedule, email vitthalmirji@gmail.com with:

  • invoice/payment reference
  • date and amount
  • reason for request
  • any relevant context

You can also reach us at:

  • Mobile: +91-9845-630-306

10. Limitation of liability

To the maximum extent permitted by law:

11. Disputes, chargebacks, and evidence

Card payments may allow customers to raise disputes/chargebacks through their bank. If a dispute arises, you agree to cooperate in good faith, and we may provide documentation such as invoices, written scope, delivery evidence (emails, meeting notes), and timelines to the payment processor/bank.

12. Grievance and support
